p: perish one day by the hand: David distrusts God's protection and therefore flees to the idolaters, who were enemies to God's people.
dwelt with Achish at Gath: Thus God by his providence changes the enemies hearts, and makes them favour his in their need.
let them give me a place: Let your officers appoint me a place.
Geshurites: These were the wicked Canaanites, whom God had appointed to be destroyed.
Jerahmeelites: A family of the tribe of Judah, 1Ch 2:9.
